rules.claim_selection: bisect_left: first claim at/after label_time - tolerance, as in pp_bench.accuracy

classification_method: Evidence-conservative geometry and adjacent-frame timing diagnostics; no kit-only identity inference.
definition_mismatches: pp_bench.accuracy silently leaves sub-0.5 claimed frames out of its returned categories; the ledger names them unmatched.
audit_claim_outcomes.classify_claim explicitly returns unmatchedClaim for the same sub-0.5 geometry.

interval_scores.score selects the nearest timeline sample, whereas pp_bench.accuracy uses the first claim at/after t-tol. Here claims are sampled on the same 0.1 s grid, so this does not change the 31-frame result.
The report's 31.3 claimedCorrectSec / 0 wrongIdentitySec does not expose unmatched or abstained counts; those require the explicit ledger partition.

rows.classification_evidence: Local crops at 243.4/244.4/245.4s show #20 and an adjacent orange player overlapping; the claim only clips the T box (IoU 0.088) and is centred toward the adjacent player, which has no separate annotation. Identity is therefore not established.
